<SPAN 1>THIS AGREEMENT </SPAN 1><SPAN 2>is made the …… day of ………………….in the year of ……</SPAN 2>
<SPAN 3>BETWEEN:-</SPAN 3>
<SPAN 4>(1) ………………………… </SPAN 4><SPAN 5>(disclosing party) of……………………………………</SPAN 5>
<SPAN 6>ABN: ………………………………………………………...</SPAN 6>
<SPAN 7>(2) EFCA Pty Ltd (receiving party) of 28 Blanche St, St Kilda, Victoria 3182</SPAN 7>
<SPAN 8>ABN: 15 120 483 650</SPAN 8>
<SPAN 9>WHEREAS:-</SPAN 9>
<SPAN 10>(A) The parties for their mutual benefit may have exchanged and wish further to exchange certain confidential information (including but not limited to trade secrets and proprietary know-how).</SPAN 10>
<SPAN 11>(B) The parties wish to define their rights with respect to the said information and protect the confidentiality thereof and proprietary features contained therein.</SPAN 11>
<SPAN 12>(C) Subject or purpose of agreement………………………………………………</SPAN 12>
<SPAN 13>IN CONSIDERATION of the undertakings given by the parties hereto the parties HEREBY AGREE as follows:</SPAN 13>
<SPAN 14>1. Definitions</SPAN 14>
<SPAN 15>In this Agreement:-</SPAN 15>
<SPAN 16>Confidential Information means any and all information which is now or at any time disclosed to one party by the other party and shall include without limitation, data, know-how, formulae, recipes, processes, designs and design rights, photographs, drawings, plans, intentions, product information, trade secrets, market opportunities, specifications, manufacturing data, which is disclosed to EFCA before or after the date of this Agreement but shall exclude any part of such information which:-</SPAN 16>
<SPAN 17>1.1 is or becomes in the public domain without breach of this Agreement by EFCA; or</SPAN 17>
<SPAN 18>1.2 EFCA can show:-</SPAN 18>
<SPAN 19>1.2.1 was in its possession or known to it by being in its use or being recorded in its files or computers or other recording media prior to receipt from the disclosing party and which was not previously acquired by EFCA from the disclosing party under an obligation or confidence, or</SPAN 19>
<SPAN 20>1.2.2 to have been developed by EFCA, or EFCA’s principals, at any time independently of any information disclosed to it by the disclosing party.</SPAN 20>
<SPAN 21>2. Handling of Confidential Information</SPAN 21>
<SPAN 22>EFCA shall maintain the disclosing party’s Confidential Information in confidence and shall exercise in relation thereto no lesser security measures and degree of care than those which the receiving party applies to its own confidential information and which EFCA warrants as providing adequate protection against unauthorised disclosure, copying or use. </SPAN 22><SPAN 23>EFCA shall ensure that disclosure of such Confidential Information is restricted to those employees or directors of EFCA and EFCA’s principals having the need to know the same. </SPAN 23><SPAN 24>Copies or reproductions shall not be made except to the extent reasonably necessary and all copies made shall be the property of the disclosing party.</SPAN 24>
<SPAN 25>3. Return of Confidential Information</SPAN 25>
<SPAN 26>3.1 EFCA shall:</SPAN 26>
<SPAN 27>3.1.1 immediately upon receipt of a written request from the disclosing part, return to the disclosing party all documents and materials (and all copies thereof) containing the disclosing party’s Confidential Information and certify in writing to the disclosing party that it has complied with the requirements of this sub-clause; and</SPAN 27>
<SPAN 28>3.1.2 notwithstanding the completion of any purpose for which any Confidential Information has been disclosed or the return of documents and materials as aforesaid, continue to the bound by the undertakings set out in clauses 2, 4 and 5.</SPAN 28>
<SPAN 29>4. Limitations and Warranty</SPAN 29>
<SPAN 30>4.1 EFCA shall:</SPAN 30>
<SPAN 31>4.1.1 not divulge the disclosing party’s Confidential Information, in whole or in part, to any third party; and</SPAN 31>
<SPAN 32>4.1.2 make no commercial use of the same or any part thereof without the prior written consent of the disclosing party. </SPAN 32><SPAN 33>Notwithstanding the foregoing, EFCA shall be entitled to make any disclosure required by law of the disclosing party’s Confidential Information provided that it gives the disclosing party not less than two business days’ notice of such disclosure.</SPAN 33>
<SPAN 34>4.2 </SPAN 34><SPAN 35>The disclosing party reserves all rights in its Confidential Information and no rights or obligations other than those expressly recited herein are granted or to be implied from this Agreement. </SPAN 35><SPAN 36>In particular, no licence is hereby granted directly or indirectly under any patent, invention, discovery, copyright or other industrial property right now or in the future held, made, obtained or licensable by the other party. </SPAN 36><SPAN 37>Nothing herein contained shall be deemed to impose on either party any obligation to give the other party the opportunity of giving a quotation or making a tender to the other party or to enter into any contract for services or for supply of goods and/or materials with the other party.</SPAN 37>
<SPAN 38>5. Confidentiality</SPAN 38>
<SPAN 39>EFCA agrees to keep the existence and nature of this Agreement confidential and not to use the same or the name of the disclosing party (or of any company in the Group of Companies of which the disclosing party forms part) in any publicity, advertisement or other disclosure with regard to this Agreement without the prior written consent of the disclosing party.</SPAN 39>
<SPAN 40>6. Notices</SPAN 40>
<SPAN 41>Any notice to be given under this Agreement shall be in writing and sent by facsimile transmission or sent by recorded delivery post to the receiving party at its business address as last notified in writing to the other party and shall be deemed to have been given on the date of the facsimile transmission or two days following that on which the notice was posted.</SPAN 41>
<SPAN 42>7. Variations</SPAN 42>
<SPAN 43>No variation, alteration or modification of this Agreement will be valid unless in writing signed by a duly authorised representative of both parties.</SPAN 43>
<SPAN 44>8. Non-Assignment</SPAN 44>
<SPAN 45>This Agreement is personal to the parties and shall not be assigned or otherwise transferred in whole or in part by either party without the prior written consent of the other party.</SPAN 45>
<SPAN 46>9. Entire Agreement, Governing Law and Jurisdiction</SPAN 46>
<SPAN 47>This Agreement constitutes the entire Agreement and understanding between the parties in respect of Confidential Information and supersedes all previous agreements, understandings and undertakings in such respect. </SPAN 47><SPAN 48>This Agreement cannot be changed except by written agreement between the parties. </SPAN 48><SPAN 49>The interpretation, construction and effect of this Agreement shall be enforced in accordance with the laws of the State of Victoria.</SPAN 49>
<SPAN 50>This agreement will be effective as of the date below, and continue for five (5) years.</SPAN 50>
<SPAN 51>Signed on behalf of ……………………………………</SPAN 51>
<SPAN 52>……………………………………………</SPAN 52>
<SPAN 53>Date ……………………………………</SPAN 53>
<SPAN 54>Witnessed by: ………………………………………………..</SPAN 54>
<SPAN 55>Signed on behalf of EFCA Pty Ltd</SPAN 55>
<SPAN 56>……………………………………………</SPAN 56>
<SPAN 57>Date ……………………………………</SPAN 57>
<SPAN 58>Witnessed by:………………………………………………..</SPAN 58>
